nodes.title: Homosexuality is Impossible
nodes.subtitle: Homosexuality under the classic definition of "same sex attraction is impossible.

blocks.label: ATTRACTION
blocks.text: to feel a pull to someone through the appeal to own desires and tastes

blocks.label: THE PROBLEM
blocks.text: Under this definition, attraction is synonymous to liking & loving. It is reductive and does not address the biology behind the phenomenon of attraction. Through this definition, there is no way of explaining the phenomenon that gets a male to mate with a female over any other female.

blocks.label: Conclusion
blocks.text: The term attraction needs to be brought back to its original roots, when it was strictly a medical term.

blocks.label: ATTRACTION
blocks.text: a reproductive pathway designed to initiate sex

blocks.label: JUSTIFICATION
blocks.text: This definition addresses the problem. It defines attraction as one of the steps of reproduction, showing its purpose.

steps.label: ARGUMENT
steps.text: A common argument may be to treat homosexuality as a malfunction of the reproductive pathway.

steps.label: EXPLANATION
steps.text: This thought comes from the further misunderstanding of the terms, attraction & sex, under this framework, are solely reproductive terms.

steps.label: ARGUMENT
steps.text: Some people claim will use the phenomenon of same sex intimate acts happening in nature.

steps.label: EXPLANATION
steps.text: This confuses intimate acts with the act of sex. Sex is solely reproductive under this framework.

blocks.label: SEX (ACT)
blocks.text: a physical activity between people involving the vaginas, mouths or anus' contact with the opposing genitals

blocks.label: THE PROBLEM
blocks.text:
This definition treats sex as an intimate activity involving penetration that is only limited to the mouth, anus or vagina. This definition is logically fallacious (ad populum), as it has no justification for why only these 3 parts should be considered as part of a sexual intercourse and others not (such as ear, nose, open wounds, belly buttons, etc), other than that most people consider it that way. 
It also fails to describes sex as the act that leads to pregnancy.

blocks.label: CONCLUSION
blocks.text: The act of sex needs to be defined medically and evolutionary.

blocks.label: SEX
blocks.text: a reproductive pathway that leads to the delivery of semen to the fallopian tubes.

blocks.label: JUSTIFICATION
blocks.text: This definition addresses the problem. It, too,  defines sex as one of the steps of reproduction, showing its purpose.

steps.label: ARGUMENT

steps.label: EXPLANATION

items.title: Possibility of Sex in Infertile Individuals

steps.label: ARGUMENT
steps.text: A common response is saying infertile individuals cannot then have sex under this definition

steps.label: EXPLANATION
steps.text: This is a strawman, ignoring the word "designed". Designed means that is its intention, but is not necessary the result.

items.title: Would that mean isolated implantation is sex?

steps.label: CLARIFYING
steps.text: No, the pathway consists of the physical penetration of the vagina by the penis.

blocks.label: EXPLANATION
blocks.text:
On top of the fact it ignores the framework, I'm rather skeptical of the possibility of a malfunction. The pathway attraction relies on is built on multiple physiological mechanisms: 
- pheromones & chemical cues
- shape recognition by eyes

blocks.label: PHEROMONES
blocks.text: Males don't react to male pheromones the same way females do. Females don't react to female pheromones the same way males do. Males through chemical cues can sense when a female is ovulating, raising their testosterone. There's no evidence of malfunction on this mechanism.

blocks.label: SHAPE RECOGNITION
blocks.text:
Males, under natural circumstances, do not possess the same anatomy as females, lacking the curvature of the hips, breasts, face softness, fat distribution, waist to hip ratio, skin quality, muscle insertions, muscle mass, body hair distribution. Vice versa for females. There's no evidence of malfunction on this mechanism.

items.title: Study showing "Gay" Males react to Male pheromones

steps.label: ARGUMENT
steps.text: A study by Ivanka Savic shows activation of certain parts of the brain in "Gay" males from male pheromones

steps.label: METHODOLOGICAL CRITIQUE
steps.text: This study has many methodological problems. It disclosed to the "gay" males that they will be smelling male pheromones, which can result in bias and placebo effects. Extremely high dosage, synthetic pheromones,

steps.label: CRITIQUE OF CONCLUSION
steps.text: Activation of certain parts of brain can indeed happen through the smell of pheromones, no matter the sex the of objects. However, concluding activation as attraction does not follow (non sequitur).

items.t: Ivanka Savic - Gays react to Male Pheromones

If we hypothetically put 2 isolated anuses in front of the subject and the only variable are the titles of "male" and "female", and the subject picks male, then the subjects decision is driven by arbitrary social grooming and has no psycho-physiological backing.

steps.text: Some claim the G-Spot (the region with the highest nerve endings) in males is located inside the anus. That is a misconception, it's located on the penile glands foreskin.

steps.text:
Some people will make various analogies trying to compare the anus to the hand. However, we can counter the analogies with our own. 
- an eye's function is to see, just because some people cant see, doesn't mean eyes arent a seeing organ. the same applies to the anus

steps.text: Controlling for horniness, there's no explanation for why a female would prefer an intimate act with a female rather than a male other than societal grooming.

blocks.label: Conclusion
blocks.text: Same-Sex intimate acts and tendencies for them, are not rooted in anything psycho-physiological, but rather are fetishes or consequences of societal or personal grooming.

blocks.label: EXPLANATION
blocks.text:
Now, that I've demonstrated that:
- same sex attraction is impossible
- same sex intercourse is impossible
- the phenomenon of same sex intimate acts not being psycho-physiological

The concept of homosexuality under the mainstream definition is impossible.

blocks.label: PROPOSAL
blocks.text: We can redefine homosexuality to more clearly explain the intent and thought behind it, its reasoning of existence. The definition will be a sociological one, rather than a biological one, relying on it as a social construct.

blocks.label: HOMOSEXUALITY
blocks.text: An intense liking of someone of one's own sex, that leads to intimate acts with someone of own sex.

blocks.label: Conclusion
blocks.text: Homosexuality is only possible if redefined into a non reproductive, non biological, societal definition.
